_comment: The labelling node of this instance's skills/ (#980: nesting is described FROM WITHIN). Two lists, one node: `topics` names subdirectories that hold skill PACKAGES (bean 9umr, read by scripts/skill-topics.ts); `directories` names INSTANCE directories declared inside skills/ (bean cmsl, owner 2026-09-30, round 4), resolved exactly as if <instance>.json declared them, which it did until this change. Paths are relative to this file's directory.

directories.description: Editorial voice profiles derived from this layer's own `library/` -- `who-digital-health` is the first. Every rule cites `{ libraryId, sectionId, pages, quote }` resolving into `library/`, and `check:voices` refuses one whose citation does not resolve, which is what makes a voice auditable rather than asserted. The id is `voices`, the CONVENTIONAL one, so this overrides the default rather than joining it. Declared in the commit that created its content. Issue #877, bean `7mi0`.
